The main takeaway from our work is that

agile distributed development can work well, if the project is managed by an experienced and competent team, and if the project is supported by a communication technology that is able to support the enactment of a variety of formal and informal controls.
control is not a static property, but rather an emergent phenomenon, and that the use of media and context is a key to understanding the dynamics of control in distributed software development.
